### SW-000 Short title

- **Statement:** The <system/component> shall <measurable behaviour> when <condition> within <limit>.
- **Rationale:** Why this is needed (and what happens if it is not met).
- **Parent:** SYS-000
- **Acceptance criteria:** Pass/fail condition, with numbers and tolerances.
- **Verification method:** Test | Inspection | Analysis | Demonstration
- **Verified by:** TC-000
- **Category:** Functional | Performance | Safety | Security | Testability | Auditability | ...
- **Regulatory:** none | <legal act + article/annex, standard + clause>   (also add a row to docs/regulatory/compliance-matrix.md)
- **Priority:** Must | Should | Could
- **Status:** Draft | In Review | Approved | Superseded | Withdrawn
